predeclared_reproduction_supersession_20.one_sentence: The check compared production against a single draw from a quantity that has no stable value, using a band narrower than that quantity's own spread, so it was never capable of the discrimination its name claims.

why_the_original_verdict_is_retired.mechanism: WRONG POPULATION. The gap was divided by the PRODUCTION scatter (1.26775e-4), giving 188.4x, but the band guards a comparison against the DIAGNOSTIC configuration, whose own scatter is sd 0.024701703.
why_the_original_verdict_is_retired.reading: Against the population the comparison is actually against, the gap is UNDER ONE standard deviation by either reference. The 188.4x is an artefact of the denominator, not a measurement of disagreement.
why_the_original_verdict_is_retired.known_issues_entry: KNOWN_ISSUES.md:52 entry 41 | TRAP | RETRACTED -- do not quote one-shot results from the unstable diagnostic wrapper family as estimator properties

the_window_was_never_passable.note: This is the load-bearing argument because it uses NO fitted distribution and no n=3 standard deviation. Realized containment only (BEN-025).
the_window_was_never_passable.window_centre_is: exactly the 56534117 diagnostic draw -- one observation
the_window_was_never_passable.conclusion: A +/-0.01 band centred on one draw from a process whose observed spread is 2.239x the full band width, which its own generator then falls outside of 1 time in 3. Production missing it is not evidence about production.
the_window_was_never_passable.production_vs_worst_diagnostic_run: production is CLOSER to the diagnostic mean (0.4796 sd) than the diagnostic's own 56611394 is (1.1503 sd). Both outside the window.

positive_evidence_that_production_is_sta.why_it_matters: Different code paths, same checkpoints -- exactly the comparison CODE_PATHS_DISAGREE names. The production family is stable to machine precision, so the instability is entirely on the diagnostic side.

what_this_does_NOT_claim: It does not claim the full-LR baseline recovery 0.546853 is inflated. Job 56818470 measured fold-forward SIGN behaviour, not recovery; "tail collapse inflates recovery" remains a mechanism argument, not a measurement.
It does not call the 56534117 draw an outlier. The configuration has no stable point value, so there is nothing for it to be an outlier from.
It does not re-open or re-run anything. No fourth diagnostic run: the predeclaration itself declined one -- "A fourth run would refine sd 0.0247 without changing any decision."
It does not promote past a red check. The check is mis-specified; that is a different claim and a stronger one.
